title: Socure acquires Fravity AI for $156 million to enhance identity verification
source_used: Socure press release of 27 Aug 2026 (MSSP Alert article blocked by a Cloudflare page, 403)
key_facts: Socure announced on 27 Aug 2026 a strategic growth investment valuing it at $5.2 billion and the acquisition of Fravity, an agentic platform that automates fraud, risk and compliance operations.
Summit Partners led the investment, with Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Wells Fargo, Docusign and others; it includes primary capital and an employee secondary tender offer.
Fravity will be delivered through Socure's RiskOS platform as "RiskOS_Agents".
Socure says it closed Q2 2026 with $364 million total ARR and more than 3,000 customers.
Socure says Fravity has cut cost per case by 80% and false positives by up to 70% across its deployments.
The press release gives no price for Fravity.
The MSSP Alert headline gives $156 million; that figure could not be checked.
quote_evidence: today announced a strategic growth investment that values the company at $5.2 billion, alongside the acquisition of Fravity, an agentic platform that automates fraud, risk, and compliance operations.
Across its existing deployments, Fravity has reduced cost per case by 80%, accelerated case resolution by up to 5x, and cut false positives by as much as 70%.
why_it_matters_hint: The deal itself dates from 27 Aug 2026; only the reported $156 million price is new, and it is unconfirmed.
notes: MSSP Alert page blocked (Cloudflare 403) and no other outlet found. The underlying acquisition was announced by Socure on 27 Aug 2026 without a price, so the item is old news with an unverified price. Entry kept to one cautious sentence.
